Tessa — thanks for the ping and the attachments. Quick technical read: the latency_trace shows repeated decode stalls (several requests with step latencies ~150–250ms at decode loop) and a subset of 5xx errors are OOM-related decoder exceptions on the RTX-accelerated instances. The new kernel selection in v4.1 is attempting a faster matmul kernel on odd sequence lengths; on a few cards that appears to regress memory working set and trigger decoder retries.

Immediate mitigation options (in order):
1) Traffic split: shift MerchantBridge back to v3.9 (stable qprofile) for 100% for 20 min, validate behavior, then gradual reintroduce. Risk: small rolling-window cost increase as v3.9 is less quantized.
2) If rollback not acceptable, pin v4.1 but force decoder to fallback kernel (software decode) for MerchantBridge only — less efficient but avoids OOMs.
3) If hardware-specific, move traffic to a different GPU pool (non-RTX) with compatible kernel schedule.

I can push 1) within ~12 minutes. We should prepare a one-pager for execs summarizing customer impact and estimated cost delta.

Karthik
Principal SRE — Serving Runtime
